# Cognexa

> Cognexa is a South African AI business solutions agency that designs and builds AI chatbots and WhatsApp automation, AI voice agents, workflow automation and immersive 3D websites. Scoping is free, quotes are fixed, and there is no minimum contract; built in South Africa, Cognexa works with clients worldwide and delivers POPIA-aware builds.

Cognexa is based in Centurion, Gauteng, and replies to every enquiry within one business day. Core offerings include AI receptionists, WhatsApp and website chatbots, automated quoting and invoicing, appointment booking and reminders, email triage, CRM automation and custom CRM development. Plain-English articles on AI chatbots, AI receptionists, voice agents and workflow automation are published at https://cognexa.co.za/blog.html.

## Services

- [AI chatbots & WhatsApp automation](https://cognexa.co.za/): Website chat and WhatsApp automation that answers instantly, qualifies leads and books the meeting, then hands off to your team with full context.
- [AI receptionists & voice agents](https://cognexa.co.za/): Inbound reception and outbound follow-up handled by natural-sounding AI voice agents that book, remind, confirm and escalate when a human should step in.
- [Workflow automation — quoting, invoicing, bookings, inbox triage, CRM](https://cognexa.co.za/): CRM, calendar, invoicing and inbox wired together into AI workflows that move work forward without anyone pushing it.
- [3D web experiences](https://cognexa.co.za/): Immersive, scroll-driven 3D websites designed, built and tuned for performance.

## Insights

- [AI Receptionist Cost in South Africa (2026 Guide)](https://cognexa.co.za/ai-receptionist-cost-south-africa.html): What an AI receptionist costs in South Africa — real vendor pricing in Rand, compared against local receptionist salaries.
- [AI Receptionist vs Human Receptionist vs Answering Service](https://cognexa.co.za/ai-receptionist-vs-human-receptionist.html): Capability, caller experience and cost compared, plus when a call should be handed to a person.
- [AI Workflow Automation for Small Business: 12 Wins](https://cognexa.co.za/small-business-ai-workflow-automation-examples.html): Twelve concrete workflows small businesses can automate first — lead handling, admin, follow-up, reporting — and what to leave to people.
- [Is a WhatsApp AI Chatbot POPIA Compliant?](https://cognexa.co.za/whatsapp-ai-chatbot-popia-compliance.html): Consent rules, WhatsApp's opt-in policy and a practical compliance checklist for South African businesses.
- [AI Agent vs Chatbot: What's the Difference?](https://cognexa.co.za/ai-agent-vs-chatbot-difference.html): A chatbot answers, an AI agent acts — what each can do, how build and running costs differ, and which one a business should start with.
- [How Long Does AI Automation Take to Set Up?](https://cognexa.co.za/how-long-ai-automation-setup-roi.html): Realistic build timelines for chatbots, voice agents and workflow automation, why enterprise timelines mislead small businesses, and how to work out payback.
- [Can an AI Chatbot Speak Afrikaans and isiZulu?](https://cognexa.co.za/ai-chatbot-south-african-languages.html): How well AI chatbots and voice agents handle South Africa's languages, why voice is harder than text, code-switching, and how to test quality before committing.
